## Statement

A statement in the words of the test.

## Proof

By Lagrange's theorem, the order of $H$ divides the order of $G$. By [the theorem of Sylow](5ZQ1PM), a subgroup of order $p^k$ exists, and Cauchy's theorem gives an element of order $p$. The Feit–Thompson theorem is not needed. A user's lemma in `Smith's lemma` is code.
